title: 冰箱里没有牛奶  (No Milk in the Fridge)

segments.t: Back in the café kitchen, Mei opens the fridge and gasps just as Qing and Manager Zhou step in. Eight guests are waking up upstairs, and breakfast begins in twenty minutes. Listen first.
糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
看我的！快说要买什么。
三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
你们守着，我出门啦！
Now let's go through the conversation, line by line.
糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
'Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!' Kitchen crisis opener:
糟了
literally says 'things have gone spoiled', the everyday cry for 'uh-oh!' or 'oh no!'.
我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
'I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!' Before a negative command,
千万
literally 'ten million times', adds urgent pleading: 'whatever you do, don't!'.
送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
'The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!' Look inside
冰箱
built from 'ice' plus 'box', a crystal-clear name for a refrigerator.
只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
'Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!' Saying 'one bit of butter all have-not' is Mandarin's emphatic pattern for 'no butter whatsoever'.
还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
'Thankfully the bread dough in the oven is already ready.' Relief in two syllables:
还好
literally 'still good', works just like 'thankfully' or 'at least'.
十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
'Can you run there and back within ten minutes?' Joining 'come' and 'return' forms
来回
a neat noun for a round trip there and back.
三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
'Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!' Cold bottled drinks take
瓶
right after the number, giving Mei 'three bottle-milk'.
钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
'Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!' Spoken Mandarin uses
块
literally 'piece', for yuan bills in everyday shopping. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
看我的！快说要买什么。
三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
你们守着，我出门啦！
Armed with a shopping list and fifty yuan from the cash box, Qing sprints toward the corner market. Let's see what she brings back next time.
回头见！
